plugins.faceIDPermission: REOS uses Face ID so you can open the app quickly and securely. Your face data stays on your phone.

plugins.microphonePermission: REOS uses the microphone in video sessions with your instructor or mentor, and when you hold the mic to add a to-do.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: REOS turns what you say into a to-do. Nothing is saved until you check it and tap Save.

plugins.contactsPermission: REOS looks up a name you say ("call Maria") in your contacts so the to-do can link to them. Your contacts stay on your phone.

plugins.cameraPermission: REOS uses the camera in video sessions with your instructor or mentor. You can turn it off at any time in the session.
